results.output: Lucid Sentence is a free, open-source word processor designed for .docx files. It preserves Word's familiar ribbon interface, enabling users familiar with the application to locate every command efficiently. The interface features a refined aesthetic with careful typography. The application runs on desktop, Android, and as a home-screen web app on iPhone and iPad. Optional on-device AI capabilities allow for the rewriting of selections, grammar correction, summarization, and conversion of plain-language requests into ribbon commands. All AI edits are presented as suggestions that the user accepts or rejects; consequently, the document remains unchanged behind the writer's back.
The team has gone to the meeting yesterday and they were very happy with their results, which is a good outcome.

Lucid Sentence is a free, open-source word processor that offers a familiar ribbon interface and a modern look, running on desktop, Android, and web, with optional AI features that rewrite and fix text without altering the document.
